_meta.description: Lore tips displayed during loading screens. Random selection each transition.

tips: Coppervale was founded by survivors who believed in building, not fighting.
The Sundering destroyed 90% of the Old World's infrastructure in a single day.
DEJIN stands for Distributed Electronic Joint Intelligence Network.
Aetheric Ore is the key to Pre-War technology — handle with care.
Captain Harrow served in three campaigns before finding peace in Coppervale.
The Rusty Gear Tavern has never closed, even during raids. Kaydee insists.
Machines need regular maintenance. A well-oiled turret fires twice as fast.
Every Remembrance Day, Coppervale lights lanterns for those who came before.
Old Maren's husband Oren was the first engineer of Coppervale.
The Iron Marauders unified under the Marshal in just two years.
Spark once tried to fit 17 gears on a single coupling. The maximum is 14.
Trade routes bring more than goods — they bring hope and connection.
The Grand Spire was once the tallest building on the continent.
Pip's scrap collection contains at least three items of genuine historical value.
A mech's legs are its most vulnerable component. Protect them in combat.
The Beacon Council connects settlements across a 200-kilometer radius.
Pre-War automatons were designed to assist, not to fight. War changed that.
Coppervale's walls have been rebuilt three times. Each time, stronger.
The Ashspine Mountains contain mineral deposits that could sustain industry for decades.
Fog reduces turret accuracy by 30%. Plan your defenses accordingly.
Night raids grant enemies a stealth bonus. Keep the spotlights burning.
The Tide Reavers attack from the water. Standard walls won't stop their divers.
A quality rating of 'Excellent' on a machine reduces maintenance frequency by half.
Festivals boost town morale and NPC productivity for the following season.
Data Cores come in four types: Blue (technical), Red (military), Gold (personal), Black (classified).
The Workshop's Assembly Crane can build machines that would take a team of engineers weeks.
Seasonal weather affects crop yields, patrol visibility, and raid difficulty.
Heart events trigger at specific locations during specific times. Pay attention to NPC schedules.
The Forge consumes fuel with every craft. Stock up before big projects.
Every settlement in the Beacon network has a unique specialty and trade goods.
